requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions address SMB needs for efficiency and ROI, making printer management easier for non-IT users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software development and integration with SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for print, scan, and device management are fully functional and accessible via the SMB portal; usability testing with target users demonstrates improved efficiency.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver the lowest TCO in HP's business printer portfolio, focusing on cost efficiency for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and cost efficiency; lowest TCO is a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires optimization of ink usage, maintenance, and supplies costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Third-party validation or internal analysis confirms Magellan's TCO is lower than competitors and existing HP business printers for target usage profiles.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the printer's plastic content is from recycled sources, exceeding competitor benchmarks.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a top customer and corporate priority; differentiates HP from Epson (30%) and others.
requirements.Dependencies: Sourcing of recycled materials, regulatory compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party audits confirm 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: First Business Ink Tank Printer for HP
requirements.Description: Develop and launch HP's first business-class ink tank printer, targeting the CISS PLE Hi segment.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio and captures new market share in a growing segment.
requirements.Dependencies: New hardware platform development; CISS technology integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launch with ink tank technology, positioned and marketed as HP's first business ink tank printer.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a user-replaceable maintenance box to reduce service intervention and downtime for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance costs and complexity for businesses without dedicated IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and supply chain for replaceable parts; user training materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace the maintenance box with minimal tools; documentation and support materials provided.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated online portal for SMB customers to manage multiple printers, monitor usage, and access support.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies fleet management for non-IT users in SMBs; enhances customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with device firmware, cloud infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, supports multi-device management, and passes usability tests with target users.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Keyed Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles for easy, error-proof refilling by customers, minimizing service calls and spillage.
requirements.Rationale: Supports SMBs without IT staff; reduces user errors and maintenance needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and manufacturing of keyed bottles; compatibility with printer hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles can only fit the correct tank; user testing confirms ease of use and prevention of errors.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages printed or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Builds customer trust and supports the SMB use case for reliability and durability.
requirements.Dependencies: Service infrastructure and warranty policy alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly stated in product materials and honored in all supported markets.

requirements.Title: PHA – Customer Replaceable and MINK at Service Centre
requirements.Description: Design for customer replaceable PHA (Primary Handling Assembly) and MINK (maintenance kit) at service centers, with a target for customer replaceability if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and service costs for SMBs; aligns with low-intervention goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for serviceability; training and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA is customer replaceable; MINK replaceable at service centers; instructions provided.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB 2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Ensure non-PDL SKUs support SMB 2.0 Solutions and provide access to the Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers differentiated experience for SMBs via software and services.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs ship with SMB 2.0 Solutions and portal access enabled.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Increased Print Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: PDL SKUs must support print speeds of at least 25/20 ppm (improvement over current 25/19), and include PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support.
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of higher-end SMBs and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware capability; PDL/PS licensing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves target speeds in lab tests; PDL/PS support verified by print job compatibility.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses environmental and regulatory requirements; enhances sustainability credentials.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation for certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App for Magellan users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a key use case for modern SMBs; increases product appeal.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App integration; testing across platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices using the HP App; compatibility with iOS and Android confirmed.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive support, serviceability, and product improvement initiatives.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and cloud integration; privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely collected, transmitted, and accessible for authorized support and analytics.
